title: A Survey on Intersectional Fairness in Machine Learning: Notions, Mitigation, and Challenges
benchmark_measurement: Investigation of representational and allocational harms concerning occupational stereotypes at the intersection of religion with other attributes like sexuality and political affiliations.
findings: The paper cites a study ([Kirk et al., 2021]) that expanded intersectional bias analysis in language models to include religion, investigating representational and allocational harms related to occupational stereotypes.
